title: Law to fully exempt severely disabled veterans from property tax
summary: This bill would let New York City give a full property tax exemption on the primary residence of veterans rated 100% disabled due to a service-connected disability, if they meet state eligibility rules under Real Property Tax Law section 458-a(11). The exemption would also cover special district charges, assessments and special ad valorem levies. New York State already allows localities to offer this exemption, but the city must adopt it to apply here.
